about: lite-signal soak divergence registry (SPEC-B v2 section 4.4; S1cd amendments 5 and 8). Every behaviour the soak tolerates or explains has ONE entry here. divergences.mjs validates it (fail closed: classify throws while the registry is invalid) and classifies a failing world against it. Engine rungs APPEND entries at the end and flip fixedIn when their fix lands; ids are never reused. fixedIn = the rung whose fix has LANDED in the tree (null = still open); an entry with fixedIn set explains a failure only when classify opts.includeFixed is true (main / SoakReport set it for any named control kernel, pre- or post-fix). fixBy = the rung planned to fix it (informative). Matching: every fail of the failing step must be explained by some entry; an entry explains a fail when the engine, lane, oracle, sig, op, step scen (all-of), world scen (all-of), prior scen (all-of, needs worldScenCounts) and at least one shape (pair, anchored detail regex, co-fail (sameBody: the co-fail names the same body/effect #N), step scen all-of, world scen all-of, world scen none-of) all hold. lanes [] means no S1 matcher: such an entry names where it is observed (pending), or a conformance case, or is referenced by an allowance.

entries.decision: fixed (b103 B5, PLAN-0s-fixt TASK 12): fixedIn A2-FIX-T (0878c6b, FIX-T: a refresh / dependency pre-walk never throws a dependency's cached error, D-H; leaving an error is always a change, equals not called, D-K). Explains only when classify includeFixed is true (main / SoakReport set it = controls.name !== null: any named controls.json kernel, e.g. preb33 or rev152); on the tree an F6 shape is a regression (known=none)
entries.description: A dependency pre-walk has no catch, so a throwing computed dependency escapes it. EFFECT pre-walk: the token escapes set()/batch() unpredicted and the effect stays queued forever (O6 escape-computed + O4 effect-dead in the same step). COMPUTED pre-walk (burst 53 triage, PLAN-F-b33-1 N19; .handoff/b53-evidence/triage-SUMMARY.md, repro-a / repro-b): the token escapes an intermediate computed's pre-walk, so it neither re-runs nor bumps its version; the reader records the error, and on recovery the intermediate returns its old value, the equality cutoff keeps its version, and the reader is never refreshed: an effect stays dead with a stale ERR(computed:N) on the ENGINE side (standalone O4, no O6 in the step), a computed reader keeps a stale cached ERR(computed:N) (O1c computed-err-mismatch, and O2 glitch in a body that reads it). The reader may also get the error as a CACHED rethrow (pullComputed fast path: the throwing dependency already ran this version, so it runs no body); the soak tagger counts throw-dep-computed-prewalk only at the end of a body frame, so it misses that path (b53 t2 triage, N19.6; a tagger gap, and the tag is world-level, so it is not causal anyway). The standalone shapes therefore need a world that carries recovery-after-throw and NOT revert-after-mid-read (that world is DIV-F5's), with no throw-dep-computed-prewalk clause. Same root and same fix (FIX-T at BOTH pre-walk sites, as headpatched); ships in 1.5.2. Still NOT matched: a standalone O4 with ERR only on the model side, an O1c computed-mismatch (non-error), an O1e effect-stale, an O2 glitch or O1c computed-err-mismatch whose engine side is not ERR(computed:N), and any of these shapes in a world that lacks recovery-after-throw or carries revert-after-mid-read.

entries.decision: contract: a flush that exceeds maxFlushPasses throws 'CycleError: flush passes exceeded'; O6 (iii) predicts it
entries.description: Generator rule G7: the cycle-bomb appears only in ERROR (maxFlushPasses 8) and its effects are stopped in the same op. Where the CycleError surfaces depends on the kernel (exec.mjs creationAbort, from the lite adapter knownAs()): on a lite kernel that is no controls.json control (the tree, a scratch copy) it surfaces at the creation of e2, the effect that closes the write cycle; on a control (rev152, headpatched, preb33) it surfaces at the cyc:1 set. A world without the same-op stops (e.g. a shrink that dropped them) is outside G7: the aborted flush can leave a bomb effect queued, and its post-abort O1e is not a finding.

entries.description: Write-in-eval lost update (LEDGER #37): a computed WRITER C writes w while a reader that already read w (directly, or through a computed over w) is suspended below it; before F-b33-1 the reader keeps the old value and is never re-run (O1e effect-stale on an effect reader, O1c computed-mismatch on a computed reader, O2 glitch on a body that reads it; O4 effect-dead on an effect reader the lost update leaves never re-run, detail ends (ran 0 times this op), maintainer ruling b68, replay WIE:4:0x88c7b46b). Lane WIE only; every shape needs a world that counted wie-stale-effect or wie-stale-computed (the detector of a write landing under a reader that read the target) and none of effect-created-mid-batch / recovery-after-throw (DIV-F5 / DIV-F6 worlds; WIE generates neither).
